summary: mountainash-utils-files is a unified Python storage library that lets you read, write, and transform files across any storage system — local disk, S3, Azure, GCS, SFTP, FTP, SMB, HTTP — with one consistent API and zero boilerplate.

concepts.name: One API for every storage system
recommended_docs: StorageFacade.read(), write(), list_files(), delete() work identically on local disk, S3, Azure Blob, GCS, SFTP, FTP, SMB, and HTTP. Swap backends by changing one constructor argument.
evidence: src/mountainash_utils_files/__init__.py — 16 provider types behind one StorageFacade class

concepts.name: URL-scheme dispatch — no config required
recommended_docs: read_bytes('s3://bucket/key') — three tokens, no setup. StorageFacade.from_path('gs://...') infers GCS. Works for any registered scheme.

concepts.name: Compression + encryption as pipeline primitives
recommended_docs: Pipeline(Gzip(), GPG(recipients=['alice'])) on a write — compressed, then encrypted, in one call. Auto-detected from file extensions with infer=True.
evidence: CLAUDE.md suffix-aware inference examples; tests/storage_transforms/test_gzip.py and test_gpg.py

concepts.name: Cross-backend file transfers
recommended_docs: copy_between(local_facade, '/data/file.csv.gz', s3_facade, 's3://bucket/file.csv', source_pipeline=Pipeline(Gzip())) — decompress on the fly while streaming to S3.

concepts.name: S3-family in one class
recommended_docs: S3Settings covers AWS S3, S3 Express, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Backblaze B2 — one class, one discriminator field (FLAVOR). R2 endpoint URL is auto-derived from your account ID.
evidence: CLAUDE.md: S3Settings(FLAVOR='r2', ACCOUNT_ID='abc123', ...) with auto-derived endpoint

concepts.name: Protocol-capability awareness
recommended_docs: facade.supports(StorageListProtocol) — ask a backend what it can do before calling it. UnsupportedOperationError is clean and explicit, not AttributeError.
